_about: Where HullGrade's placed looks go on each hull, by hand, because finding them in the pixels put them anywhere (Jon, Oct 14: running lights 'random and bad', markings 'the execution is bad', the plate behind the number 'looks bad'). Keyed by the hull's path under art/sprites/hulls/ without .png; coordinates in that picture's own pixels (the full-size file). registry: the top-left of the 3x5 stencilled number, painted straight on a plain panel, and ink 'light' or 'dark' for what reads on that panel. chevrons: the tip of the first S-grade chevron on the nose, [x, y]. windows: [x, y, w, h] panes, aft to fore -- the hull's own dark glass where it has some. nav: [x, y, 'white' | 'amber'], the top-left of a 2x2 light.
